0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-8 and on a seven-game losing streak, host the San Antonio Spurs, who are 8-2 and riding an eight-game winning streak, in the Bulls' 10th game of the 2026-27 season. The Bulls sit 14th in the East and 4th in the Central, 5.5 games back, with a 0-3 home record, while the Spurs are 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West, and 4-0 on the road. There are no 2026-27 games between these teams yet, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost 0-2, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026. The Bulls are without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the Spurs are missing Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain), all listed as out.
